reports.title: Karen Edgar
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths
Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related death

concerns.quote: The provision of mental health services for children and young people in Cumbria is underfunded
concerns.hazard: underfunded mental health services for children and young people

concerns.quote: There are long delays in getting treatment
Failure to provide for these young people means they risk entering adulthood with unresolved mental health issues
concerns.hazard: unresolved mental health issues in young people

concerns.quote: Lives are lost and damaged; including the effect on families as a whole
concerns.hazard: loss and damage to lives and families

concerns.quote: The financial cost to the state of such deaths is huge; 4 paramedics attended as did an out of hours doctor; at least 11 police staff; hospital staff; A&E consultant; Local Safeguarding processes; costs of inquests and Trust's legal representation etc. all of which would be better spent on prevention
concerns.hazard: high financial cost of deaths due to inadequate mental health services

concerns.quote: It is likely that any of these problems are replicated across the country hence the reference to the | Secretary for State
concerns.hazard: replication of mental health service failures nationwide

reports.title: Robyn Skilton: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: Robyn was failed by the Mental Health Services quite frankly due to the current lack of resourcing and provision in place to support young people struggling with their mental health
concerns.hazard: lack of resourcing and provision of mental health services for young people

concerns.quote: Robyn initial acceptance into tier 3 Children and Mental Health Services (CAMHS) similarly did not happen in a timely manner

Referrals to West Sussex CAMHS have increased by 95.6% from May 2019 (389) to May 2022 (761) West Sussex CAMHS caseload has increased by 85% from May 2019 (2239) to May 2022 (4147) West Sussex CAMHS Duty caseload has increased by 112% from May 2021 (492) to May 2022 (1494) Mental
concerns.hazard: unsustainable demand on CAMHS without increased resources

links.explanation: Both reports identify insufficient resources and provision for child and adolescent mental health services as a core problem. This leads to delays in assessment and treatment, increasing risk of harm.
links.earlier_quote: (1) The provision of mental health services for children and young people in Cumbria is underfunded.
links.later_quote: Due to the lack of availability of a Child Psychiatrist there are long waiting times for children to be assessed.
